== Summary ==
Identified: [[Hayes Hunter]].
A spectator following a game. Taken at the [[2021 World Championship]] (the Hyatt Regency Crystal City, Arlington, Virginia, 8–10 October 2021).

* '''Event:''' [[2021 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2021-10-31
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brandon Baity]] ("Here are most of the pictures I took during the weekend", forum post 1356914)
* '''Image:''' downscaled to 1920×1080 (JPEG quality 90) from the 1920×1080 forum attachment.
